end.text: The subordinate conjunction 'when' adds extra information about time.
end.sound: ssml: The subordinate conjunction <prosody rate = 'slow'> 'when'</prosody> adds extra information about time.

instruction.text: Find the subordinate clause in the sentence below.

end.text: A subordinate clause adds extra information to the main clause to form a complex sentence. It cannot form its own sentence.

atoms.a: Oliver was brushing his teeth when the cat jumped into the sink.
atoms.b: Oliver was brushing his teeth ((when the cat jumped into the sink)).

instruction.text: Find the subordinate clause in the sentence below.

atoms.a: I almost reached the school gates when I saw my friend.
atoms.b: I almost reached the school gates ((when I saw my friend)).

instruction.text: Find the subordinate conjunction in the text.

atoms.b: ((When)) the weekend finally came around, I decided to go to the playground.
atoms.sound: When the weekend finally came around, I decided to go to the playground.

atoms.b: I got in the car with my parents ((when)) I had finished eating my breakfast.
atoms.sound: I got in the car with my parents when I had finished eating my breakfast.

atoms.b: ((When)) we got to the playground, I jumped out of the car and ran straight for the swings.
atoms.sound: When we got to the playground, I jumped out of the car and ran straight for the swings.

atoms.b: I had been on the swings for a long time ((when)) I saw the yellow slide.
atoms.sound: I had been on the swings for a long time when I saw the yellow slide.

atoms.b: ((When)) it started getting dark, I decided to head home and get ready for bed.
atoms.sound: When it started getting dark, I decided to head home and get ready for bed.
